description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 6 April 2018, the first of the enhanced packs built around particular types, here Fire, Water and Dragon. Dragonite-GX's GX attack brings three Dragon-type Pokémon back from the discard pile to the Bench, and White Kyurem-GX, Reshiram-GX and Kingdra-GX join it, with Prism Star Lance and Victini and cards that strengthen Dragons. Packs held five cards, and each box of 30 held one card of Super Rare or higher. The cards are numbered to 53, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Blaine's Last Stand and Zinnia, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Switch Raft, Fiery Flint and Dragon Talon. In English many of its cards came out in Dragon Majesty in September 2018.
